overview: The committee appointed Dr. Peter Cushing as Assistant Superintendent and heard the annual Special Education Parent Advisory Council (CPAC) report. The meeting also featured several student recognitions and the approval of a 2020 field trip to France.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Financial Reports
items.summary: Approved the minutes from May 20, 2019, and authorized the payment of bills, payroll, and fund transfers after addressing questions regarding landscaping and electrical contracts.

items.title: Recognition of Ethics Bowl and Science Fair Teams
items.summary: Recognized the Medford High School Ethics Bowl team for winning regional competitions and participating in nationals, as well as students who participated in local, regional, and international science and engineering fairs.

items.title: Seal of Biliteracy and Academic Achievements
items.summary: Celebrated 18 students for earning the Massachusetts State Seal of Biliteracy and recognized Joseph Schmidt for achieving a perfect score on the AP Spanish Language and Culture exam.

items.title: Field Trip Approval: Paris and Provence
items.summary: Approved a 2020 high school trip to France costing $3,000 per student, covering airfare, insurance, and guided tours.

items.title: Appointment of Assistant Superintendent
items.summary: Voted to appoint Dr. Peter Cushing as the new Assistant Superintendent following a recommendation from the Superintendent.

items.title: Subcommittee Reports and Policy Updates
items.summary: Accepted reports from the Support Service and Rules subcommittees, adopting updated policies for medication administration and school meal charges.

items.title: Superintendent's Update
items.summary: Provided a status report on upcoming graduation ceremonies, spring sports tournaments, the unveiling of 3D sidewalks at elementary schools, and summer camp offerings.

items.title: CPAC Annual Update
items.summary: Heard a report from the Special Education Parent Advisory Council on student inclusion rates and safety initiatives; the council also presented Director Kathleen Medaglio with the 2019 CPAC Award.

items.title: Teacher Unit Pay Frequency and Academic Reports
items.summary: Approved changes to teacher unit pay frequency and received informational reports regarding K-12 assessments and district-sponsored professional development programs.

items.title: Resolutions and Adjournment
items.summary: Passed a resolution of condolence for former teacher Margaret Peggy Kane and held a moment of silence for victims of the Virginia Beach shooting before entering executive session.
